title: Πολιτιστικές εμπειρίες
description: Ten standalone stories about experiencing Greek culture: theatre, museums, a library, language lessons, island history, traditional cooking, a cultural centre, a conference, a music festival and the Patras carnival.

lessons.title: Μια βραδιά στο θέατρο
lessons.summary: Eleni books two seats for a new play, and she and her partner Nikos enjoy the evening at an open-air theatre.

lessons.title: Το γράμμα στο μουσείο
lessons.summary: Giannis visits a war museum with his grandfather and sees a letter written by a relative who fought in the Revolution of 1821.

lessons.title: Η κάρτα της βιβλιοθήκης
lessons.summary: Claire, a Frenchwoman new to Thessaloniki, signs up at the local library and borrows a Greek translation of a French tale.

lessons.title: Ο τόνος
lessons.summary: Tom, an English student in Athens, fails his first Greek test because of the accents, practises with a strict teacher and passes the second time.

lessons.title: Ο πύργος στο νησί
lessons.summary: Maria and her brother Kostas take a boat to a small island to see its old Venetian tower and swim at a windy beach.

lessons.title: Η μυστική συνταγή της γιαγιάς
lessons.summary: Danai learns to make stuffed vine leaves with her grandmother, who shares her secret.

lessons.title: Το παλιό εργοστάσιο
lessons.summary: Stelios, who once worked in a chemical factory, visits the building with his daughter after it opens as a cultural centre.

lessons.title: Το συνέδριο στη Θεσσαλονίκη
lessons.summary: Ioanna, a scientist from Crete, gets to a conference in Thessaloniki despite a cold and a traffic jam, and enjoys a concert afterwards.

lessons.title: Δουλειά στο φεστιβάλ
lessons.summary: Pavlos, a music student, gets a summer job running the sound at a festival and keeps the concert going when it rains.

lessons.title: Το καρναβάλι της Πάτρας
lessons.summary: Sofia dresses up as a ghost for the Patras carnival, her mother wears her grandmother's old dress, and their little dog comes along too.
